description: CVE compatibility & evaluation catalog. Applicability is assessed against the ACTUAL host kernel/arch (see results/env/environment.json), not a version string on a container image. No genuine exploit is executed on the project host; Mode B (isolated reproduction) is blocked and documented. Safe simulations exercise RELATED event categories and are never labeled as real exploitation.

host_assessment_basis.note: Both installed kernels (7.1.5 and 6.19.14) are far newer than every affected range below, so all three CVEs assess as NOT APPLICABLE for genuine reproduction here.

modes.A: Safe simulation — benign workloads exercising related process/file/network event categories. NOT proof of exploitation.
modes.B: Isolated vulnerable-lab reproduction — requires a compatible, disposable, snapshot-backed, isolated VM that is explicitly configured and verified. Not implemented automatically. Currently BLOCKED.
modes.C: Recorded evidence — replay of previously captured benign/related telemetry, clearly labeled recorded.

cves.name: Dirty Pipe
cves.impact: Local unprivileged user can overwrite data in read-only files, enabling privilege escalation.

applicability.reason: Host kernels 7.1.5 and 6.19.14 are past the fixed 5.x releases (5.16.11/5.15.25/5.10.102); the uninitialized pipe_buffer.flags bug is remediated. Backport risk does not apply: the fix predates these kernels by many releases.

cves.mode_b_blocked_reason: Host kernel is not vulnerable and no isolated, snapshot-backed vulnerable VM is configured. Running a Dirty Pipe PoC on the project host is out of scope and prohibited.

simulation.category: file write / pipe + sensitive-file open telemetry
simulation.benign_workload: Controlled benign file read of /etc/shadow (E01/E07) — exercises the openat/file-access telemetry path that a real Dirty Pipe write would also surface, WITHOUT any pipe-splice overwrite.
simulation.disclaimer: This simulation only generates related file-access telemetry. It does NOT perform the pipe_buffer overwrite and is NOT evidence of exploitation or detection of Dirty Pipe.

cves.reproduction_note: No vulnerable-condition test was run; the host is not vulnerable and no isolated snapshot-backed vulnerable VM was configured. Mode B remains blocked.

cves.name: OverlayFS unprivileged capabilities
cves.impact: Local user gains elevated privileges via OverlayFS + Ubuntu's unprivileged-overlay-mount patch.

applicability.reason: The flaw depends on Ubuntu's unprivileged-overlay-mount patch. The host is Kali (not Ubuntu) on kernel 7.1.5; the required Ubuntu-specific patch is absent and the kernel is far past any affected Ubuntu build, so the environment cannot exhibit it.

cves.mode_b_blocked_reason: Wrong distribution and non-vulnerable kernel; a genuine test needs a disposable Ubuntu VM at an affected build, which is not configured. Not run on the project host.

simulation.benign_workload: Benign process-execution workloads in a container (E02/E04) — exercises the process/namespace-context telemetry a privilege-escalation chain would also touch, WITHOUT any overlay mount or capability abuse.
simulation.disclaimer: Simulation generates only benign process-execution telemetry with container context. It performs NO overlay mount and NO privilege change; it is not evidence of OverlayFS exploitation or its detection.

cves.reproduction_note: No vulnerable-condition test was run; the host is not vulnerable and no isolated snapshot-backed vulnerable VM was configured. Mode B remains blocked.

cves.name: netfilter nf_tables use-after-free
cves.impact: Local privilege escalation via a double-free reachable through nf_tables, typically entered through unprivileged user namespaces.

applicability.reason: Affected range ends before 6.8; host kernels 7.1.5 and 6.19.14 are past the last fixed branch (6.7.3). nf_tables and user namespaces are present, but the specific nft_verdict_init UAF was fixed before these versions.

cves.mode_b_blocked_reason: Host kernel is past the fixed range; a genuine test needs an isolated VM pinned to an affected kernel (e.g. 6.6.x < 6.6.15). Not configured, and exploit execution on the project host is prohibited.

simulation.benign_workload: Benign outbound HTTPS request (E03/E08) — exercises the network and process-execution telemetry surface associated with a netfilter-adjacent workload, WITHOUT touching nf_tables internals or triggering the UAF.
simulation.disclaimer: Simulation generates only benign network/process telemetry. It does NOT interact with nf_tables verdict handling and is NOT evidence of exploitation or detection of CVE-2024-1086.

cves.reproduction_note: No vulnerable-condition test was run; the host is not vulnerable and no isolated snapshot-backed vulnerable VM was configured. Mode B remains blocked.
